List GRNs, paginated. Filterable by poId/status/qaStatus.
Get a GRN with its line items, joined back to item master + PO-item ordered qty.
Record a goods receipt against a dispatched/partial_received PO. Created as draft — no stock effect until a line is QA-accepted or bypassed.
Update a draft GRN's header fields and/or line arrivedQty. Only legal while draft.
Delete a draft GRN. Only legal while draft.
QA accept/reject a GRN line. Accept posts to the inventory ledger (referenceType=grn) and rolls the PO item/status forward. Blocked past 105% of ordered qty unless the actor is owner/back_office.
Fast-track QA bypass for a GRN line (mandatory reason). Posts to the inventory ledger immediately (referenceType=grn_bypass) and rolls the PO item/status forward.
Correct a previously posted GRN line — posts a negative stock_adjustment ledger entry without mutating the original GRN line row.
List purchase orders, paginated. `overdue=true` filters to dispatched/partial_received POs past their expected delivery date with remaining qty.
Get a purchase order with its line items, joined back to the source PR lines for traceability.
Create a purchase order by drafting lines from pending PR items (full remaining PR-item quantity always used).
Update a draft purchase order's fields and/or insert/reprice/delete line items.
Cancel a purchase order — reverts linked PR items back to pending. Rejected if the PO has GRN(s) recorded. `reason` is required unless the PO is still a draft.
Mark a PO as sent to the supplier (approved -> dispatched) and log the communication.
Log a reminder sent to the supplier for an overdue PO.
Log an escalation action taken for an overdue PO.
Record a supplier-revised delivery date and delay reason. expectedDeliveryDate is never overwritten.
Record supplier confirmation of the PO. Informational only, never blocks a status transition.
Record a supplier invoice against a fully-received PO and move it to invoiced.
Close a PO (legal from fully_received or invoiced) — terminal, no further transitions.

Create a purchase requisition with its line items.

routes.summary: List pages, paginated. Legacy: replaced by GET /screens; removed in S7.
Create a page. Legacy: BR-AUTH-06 forbids creating screens; removed in S7.
Update a page (key is immutable). Legacy: replaced by PATCH /screens/:key; removed in S7.
Delete a page. Legacy: removed in S7.
List all role-page permission assignments. Legacy (role_pages): removed in S7.
notes: Bounded reference data (all role-page pairs) — pagination intentionally omitted

routes.summary: Apply an added/deleted page-permission diff for a role. Legacy (role_pages): replaced by POST /roles/:id/grants; removed in S7.
Create a role as a copy of an existing role (same keys, BR-AUTH-25).
notes: 404 source role missing; 403 SYSTEM_ROLE_PROTECTED if source is super-admin; 409 CONFLICT duplicate name. Copy is never a system role. Logged.

routes.summary: Get a role's grants: the whole key catalog with a granted flag.
notes: Bounded reference data (permission catalog) — pagination intentionally omitted
Super-admin role: readOnly=true, every key granted:true (no list to edit, BR-AUTH-18). 404 unknown role.

routes.summary: Apply a grant diff (keys added / removed) to a role.
notes: 400 KEY_NOT_GRANTABLE for setup.roles.manage (BR-AUTH-07); 400 UNKNOWN_KEY for a key not in the catalog; 403 SYSTEM_ROLE_PROTECTED for the super-admin role; 404 unknown role. Whole diff is applied in one transaction or not at all. Actor/role cache cleared. Logged with before/after.

routes.summary: List screens with the roles that see each (BR-AUTH-15).
notes: Bounded reference data (screens come from code) — pagination intentionally omitted
Ordered by menuGroup, sortOrder, key.

routes.summary: Change a screen's label, order or menu group.
notes: 404 unknown screen key; 400 for any other field (path, permissionKey are code-owned). Logged with before/after.

routes.summary: Tick / untick roles on a screen = grant / revoke the screen's key.
notes: Same grant as POST /roles/:id/grants (also opens the API). 404 unknown screen or role; 400 SCREEN_HAS_NO_KEY when permissionKey is null; 400 KEY_NOT_GRANTABLE when the key is setup.roles.manage; 403 SYSTEM_ROLE_PROTECTED for the super-admin role. One transaction, logged per role.

routes.summary: Roles the caller may assign (BR-AUTH-16).
notes: Bounded reference data (roles) — pagination intentionally omitted
Super-admin: every role. Others: roles whose keys they all hold, never the super-admin role.

routes.summary: Assign an employee's one role (BR-AUTH-08, 16, 17).
notes: 400 if body has anything but a single roleId (e.g. roleIds[]); 404 unknown employee or role; 403 ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE when the caller (non-super-admin) lacks any key of the role or targets super-admin; 409 LAST_ADMIN when it would leave no active super-admin. Actor cache cleared for that employee. Logged.

routes.summary: Read-only access log, paginated (BR-AUTH-20).
notes: No write endpoints exist. Send sortBy=at&sortDir=desc for newest first.
